about.title: About KyU Wellness
about.subtitle: An AI-supported mental health companion built for Kyambogo University students.
about.missionBody: KyU Wellness helps students notice early signs of distress, practice coping skills, and reach human support when needed. We combine supportive AI conversation with validated self-assessments and clear crisis pathways.
about.whoBody: Undergraduate and postgraduate students at Kyambogo University who want a private, calm space to talk through academic pressure, anxiety, low mood, and everyday stress.
about.how1: Chat with a CBT-informed AI companion in English or Luganda-friendly guidance.
about.how2: Take optional wellness assessments (PHQ-9, GAD-7, PSS-10) to understand how you are doing.
about.how3: Track mood and daily check-ins on your student dashboard.
about.how4: If crisis risk is detected, counselors can be alerted so you are not left alone.
about.ethicsBody: KyU Wellness does not diagnose, prescribe medication, or replace professional care. It is a support tool. In emergencies, contact campus counseling, a trusted person, or emergency services immediately.

resources.title: Mental health resources
resources.subtitle: Trusted guides and support options for students in Uganda and beyond.
resources.campusCounseling: Kyambogo University counseling / student affairs — speak with a campus counselor about academic or personal stress.
resources.campusClinic: Nearest university or community health facility — ask for mental health or psychosocial support.
resources.campusPeer: Trusted peers, wardens, or faith/community leaders you feel safe with.
resources.crisisNote: If you are in immediate danger, leave this page and get help in person now.

emergency.title: Emergency support
emergency.lead: If you might harm yourself or someone else, seek immediate in-person help now.
emergency.step1: Move to a safer place and reduce access to anything that could be used for self-harm.
emergency.step2: Contact a trusted person and tell them you need support right now.
emergency.step3: Reach campus counseling, the nearest health facility, or local emergency services immediately.
emergency.notReplacement: This platform supports you, but it is not a replacement for emergency or clinical care.
emergency.ground1: Take 10 slow breaths: inhale for 4, exhale for 6.
emergency.ground2: Name 5 things you can see, 4 you can feel, 3 you can hear.
emergency.ground3: Sip water and keep your body seated or standing in a stable posture.
emergency.contactPoliceDetail: National emergency line for immediate danger.
emergency.contactPoliceAltDetail: Also used for emergency services across Uganda.
emergency.contactButabikaDetail: National psychiatric referral hospital in Kampala. Confirm the number with current hospital listings if needed.
emergency.contactKyuDetail: Ask for student counselling / dean of students support. Update with your faculty counseling office number when available.
emergency.contactBefriendersDetail: Find emotional support and local helpline directories.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: KyU Wellness respects your privacy. This page explains what we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it.
privacy.collect1: Account details you provide (email, optional nickname, faculty, year of study).
privacy.collect2: Chat messages and assessment responses used to support your wellness.
privacy.collect3: Mood logs, check-ins, and technical logs needed to keep the service running safely.
privacy.use1: To provide AI-supported guidance and wellness tools.
privacy.use2: To detect distress and escalate to human counselors when safety risk is high.
privacy.use3: To improve the platform with aggregated, de-identified insights where possible.
privacy.shareBody: We do not sell your data. Counselors or admins may see relevant information during crisis escalation or when providing support. Legal obligations may also require disclosure in rare cases.
privacy.rights1: You can use guest mode for lighter identification.
privacy.rights2: You can stop using the service at any time.
privacy.rights3: You may request account deletion by contacting support or university administrators involved in the project.
privacy.disclaimerBody: KyU Wellness is not a substitute for professional mental health care or emergency services.

consent.title: Privacy & Consent
consent.p1: KyU Wellness collects information you provide (profile details, chat messages, assessments) to offer mental health support and detect distress when needed.
consent.p2Strong: This platform is not a replacement for professional mental health care.
consent.p2Rest: In crisis situations, we may alert university counselors to help keep you safe.
consent.li1: Your data is stored securely and used only for wellness support
consent.li2: You may use guest mode for more anonymous access
consent.li3: You can request account deletion by contacting support
consent.li4: Crisis-level messages trigger escalation to human counselors
